precommit_purpose: Scientifically evaluate frozen model forecasts on future NOAA observations, with no access to target dates by proposing models

selection_rule.if_none_qualifies: choose one of three baselines with lowest mean development-fold error
selection_rule.if_multiple_qualify: choose candidate with lowest mean development-fold error; stable Qwen-before-critic tie break

evaluation.count: 2 stations x 2 future UTC days; correlated days do not count as 4 independent scientific replications
evaluation.scoring: per-station per-day observed hourly water-level MAE, against all three precommitted baselines

privacy: No Plenum patents, private records, credentials, or confidential data may enter public GitHub workflows.
note: This protocol is committed before proposing models or downloading future test measurements. The validation data are historical, while the target-date observations are future as of the precommit.
